steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: One copy of the Central Journal, please.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: ...Zofia? Long time no see.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Same to you, Al. Actually, I'm quite surprised your stand is still running.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Haha, only by the good graces of my old regulars. Hey, out of curiosity, isn't that knight who's been on the front page recently... your niece?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Niece? Maria's like a little sister, thank you very much.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Haha! Yes, yes, I'll remember next time. I watched the match between her and Brassrust. She's got some of the same grit and spunk you had, back in the day.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Me? Not Margaret?

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: No, no. I'd never mistake it.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Haha, I'm not going to argue with you, Al. That's all in the past now.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Sure is. When I look at the news these days, they're talking about new folks every year.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Last year it was the Blood Knight, cover to cover. But this year, quite a few newly-promoted knights have made the headlines.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I saw. Maria made it too.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: There was a time when you were the talk of the town, too. Hey, what are you looking at?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: 'Four Seasons Times'? ...Is that a new one? I don't remember seeing it before.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Haha, well, take a gander at the header– 'The Whislash Knight returns to the arena as a coach, guiding Maria Nearl to defeat Ingra the Butcher.'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Never imagined there would still be reporters paying any attention to my life. I guess news of my shopping spree last weekend wasn't boring enough, so they're coming back for more.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Eh, reporters aren't the same as they used to be either. They used to sip on fine honey, but now they swallow rot.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: ...Still, this one seems to be the real deal. Picks their words carefully, and has a style that isn't overblown. Here, take a look at this!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: '...Can this up-and-comer from the Nearl family, under the guidance of the Whislash Knight, forge her own radiance in the arena?'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: 'And if so, could this mean that the Whislash Knight has re-centered herself and is ready for a comeback?'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Unfortunately... they're going to be disappointed. I'm just doing a little babysitting.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Want to take a copy home?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Thanks, but no thanks. I already hear more news than I care for these days, Al.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: See you later then, Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: One copy of the Central Journal, please.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: ...Zofia? It's been a while.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You've started selling knight merchandise too, Al?

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: These little dolls bring in good money, Zofia. Especially the Radiant Knight's. Tch, I go through sixty a day. Meanwhile, I can barely get rid of a few papers.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'll let Margaret know how much you appreciate her then. I'm sure she'd be happy to know that.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Hahaha, put it like that, and those reporters with their ears to the ground owe her their lives too. The Radiant Knight's return has been a goldmine for both scoops and sales.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Heck, maybe I should be thanking her too. Without her, I might still be coaching Maria, worrying about how to make it to the next round.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Life's a lot simpler these days. I've been looking at a nice little villa in the countryside—once the dust settles, I plan on moving out of the city.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Don't be like that, there are still plenty of people here who care about you. Here.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: 'Four Seasons Times'... Huh, they're still in print?

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: More than that, they've even set up a column dedicated to news about you. Take a look.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: 'The Whislash Knight gives up coaching Maria, wishing to return to a life of luxury.' How do I put this... My lifestyle's not THAT extravagant, is it?

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Depends on who you compare it to.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Tch. And would you look at that. You can practically taste the venom dripping from every word.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Read it out loud for me, Al. I want to hear it.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Are you sure? Their choice of words is quite... intense.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Mhm. Go ahead.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Uhh...

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: 'After Maria dropped out of the Major, Whislash also made the extremely disappointing decision to step away from her position as coach, and from the arena.'

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: 'After her retirement, she seems to have forgotten the spirit of chivalry, instead sinking into wealth-addled mediocrity, drunk off the wine of complacency.'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Pffhaha––

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: You can still laugh when they're tearing into you like that?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's obvious from how they put it that they're just a naive child who knows nothing of the world. Why bother getting mad?

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Hahaha, I suppose so.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oh, no need to put it away, Al. I'll take that one too.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: See you later then, Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: One copy of the Central Journal, please.
It's been a while, Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Tytus? What are you doing here?

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: I could ask the same of you. I assumed you'd have servants to pick up the paper for you.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Hey, you little–

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I can speak to him myself, Al.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: (Shrugs)

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Is it just me, or are you always out and about these days, Tytus? Seems like you're enjoying your retirement.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: Nothing compared to you, of course. With our champion, the Radiant Knight, at your back, I'm sure your life's positively cushy...

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: Oh, but how could I forget? Since she's been turning down all those sponsorships, maybe our champion's been sponging off of you. So how have you been? Keeping busy?

spans.text: Oh, but how could I forget? Since she's been turning down all those sponsorships, maybe our champion's been sponging off of
. So how have you been? Keeping busy?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If you know I'm busy, why waste your breath on all that nonsense?

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: (Curls lips)

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: I have some connections in the General Chamber of Commerce, and after the finals... I got some news.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: They're building a brand new arena on the newly-built plate. And while they're at it, they're probably going to develop a new commercial sector nearby. It's a good investment.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: Let me finish—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Not interested.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: Zofia, at the rate you burn through money, you'll run out one of these days, no matter how big your family business is. Not to mention those self-serving underlings you finally axed last year... Tch, now that's a royal waste of money.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That's none of your business.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: ...Well, if you're really not interested, then forget it.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: Oh right, and I say this with sincerity—Zofia, you're still very young...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Tytus, I'll listen when you have something worth saying.

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: ...In any case, spare a thought for yourself.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ah yes, thank you for your concern. See you never.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: So, are you going to buy something before you leave?

steps.name: Tytus Topola
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Looks like a lot of people have been looking for you since the Radiant Knight lifted the trophy.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret... Well, it's not like I can just leave her to her own devices either.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: You've been worrying way too much about the Nearl kids all these years, Zofia.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Well, we grew up together, and our family origins are—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hey, Al! What's that you're hiding?

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Oh, it's nothing.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hand it over.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: I told you, it's nothing.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: ...Here, it's another column from that frizzy kid. Don't get mad, they have no clue what they're talking about.
There's no text in the column, only a huge photograph occupying the entire page.
It's a picture of me sitting in the audience during the finals. The worry, uneasiness, and thick, palpable pride on my face are all clearly captured by the camera.
Even the nigh-imperceptible envy in my eyes could not escape the keen lens.
Above the photograph appears an extremely eye-catching title printed in thick, black ink.
'The Nearl Family's Best Attendant'

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The kid's got guts...

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Zofia...
Zofia offhandedly folds the newspaper to cover half the picture, obscuring the faces in the auditorium so that only the dazzling knight on the field remains.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: See you later, Al.
Miss Zofia! Miss Zofia!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Who is it? And where am I?
Hurry, wake up! I'm so glad I found you, I was scared half to death! Why were you sleeping in the bushes?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Partied too hard last night. Haven't drunk like that in a long while. Help me up, Lily.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Careful now.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Did they leave yet?

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Mmhmm. Miss Margaret and Miss Maria both had a bit much to drink, so the butler arranged for a driver to take them home not too long ago.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Where's Młynar?

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Did you forget? He didn't even stay halfway through before leaving.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...I guess I was already pretty wasted by then.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: I haven't seen you indulge yourself like that in a long time.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret deserved the toast.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Oh, allow me to see you to your bedchamber.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hold on.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Who's there? Show yourself!

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Let go! Let go of me!

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: A reporter? How'd you get in here?! Miss Zofia, should I call the police?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No need. You can head back first.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Don't worry. I can toss this runt back over the walls myself.

steps.name: Servant
steps.text: Please don't hesitate to call me if needed.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: How old are you? Fifteen? Sixteen?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: I'm an adult!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: 'Four Seasons Times'... So YOU'RE that reporter.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Please give me my badge back.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Are you aware that trespassing is a crime?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: I'm sorry... I just wanted...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Seeing how you chased me all the way here, you might as well ask what's on your mind while you've got the chance.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If you have the guts to barge into my house, surely you have the guts to sit on my sofa?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Take a seat.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's just call this an interview. I'm sure you've got pages of questions you've been itching to ask.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: I'm new to the job... I've never done an interview before.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Perfect. Now's your chance to practice.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Uhh... I'm really sorry, I broke into your house on an impulse. I'm willing to accept the consequences, be it a fine or jail time—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You know, normally an interview begins with a self-introduction. I'll get started for you.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: But—

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: My name's Zofia, formerly known as the Whislash Knight, now retired. A sister to both Maria and the Radiant Knight. Well, technically their aunt, but whatever.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'm also a VIP at Golden Palm Bank, a super-VIP at the Starlight Street shopping mall, and a swindled customer of various real estate moguls... Oh right, and occasionally the center of attention for the tabloids.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: No, that's not you...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Then who am I, in your eyes?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: I've watched the recordings of all your matches, and read every article... You were different during each phase of your career.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Then start with the 'me' you have the deepest impression of.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Oh, here it is. It's from this time... You wore a ponytail back then, just like Maria.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: After the Radiant Knight left, the decline of the Nearl family was inevitable, so you stepped into the arena seeking to save everything for her sake... I still have photos from that time.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: That was such a long time ago. Not even I kept that photo.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But yeah. Margaret went far, far, away. Młynar didn't want to become a knight, preferring to wear a tie and sit in a cubicle, so I had to step up and make something happen.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Just for the Nearl family?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Of course not. After being bathed in the Radiant Knight's light, how could I not let it touch my heart? Of course I wanted to pierce the darkness covering Kazimierz with my own strength, sword in hand.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: But you weren't able to...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hey, where'd you get that photo? Get rid of it! It makes me look ugly!

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: No! I worked so hard to buy this one!

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You kids really are something else. Why work your butt off for a picture of a knight with a bruised nose?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: This is a photo of your last fight. Ever since your defeat to Fissure in the round of 16, you were never seen in the arena again.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: My left hand was injured.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: But you fought to the end with your right.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Gee, thanks for reminding me. I'm sure I would've forgotten all about it!

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Sorry, I shouldn't have brought it up.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: It's fine. Getting injured was only part of the reason I decided to retire. There were some things buried too deeply for me to think about back then.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: But when I look back at it now, more and more I think it was the disillusionment. Though I'd already expected it to some extent, once I was fully exposed to the filth beneath the glamor of knightsports, I really couldn't find a reason to keep going.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Not everyone has the never-ending light to dispel the darkness wherever they go, like the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Most fall right there, on the cusp before daybreak. Even if they point their swords to the sky, they can only swing at the infinite darkness.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: But you were still willing to be Maria Nearl's coach and help her shine in the arena.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: All I did was teach her how to survive in the darkness.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I couldn't teach her anything I didn't know how to do myself.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I mean she managed that on her own.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Be it with Maria or Margaret... There was nothing I could do.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: At least... they were able to bring you joy with what they accomplished. Like you said in 'Sports Afternoon,' you're proud of them.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You're right, I am. The Four Seasons Times echoed a similar sentiment in that one article, 'the Nearl Family's Best Attendant.'

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: ...That was just a spur-of-the-moment thing.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (*Shakes head*) Haha, don't worry. I didn't take it personally.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: But that's not what the look on your face said. I saw you at the newsstand that day, and your expression was different from usual.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Okay, now this is getting creepy... How long have you been stalking me, kiddo?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: I've been taking photos for the last few months, but I've been following you for the last six years and twenty-eight days.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: ...Okay, you're definitely going to land yourself in jail one day.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Sure, but I'll also land myself the greatest honor a reporter can get.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Suit yourself, doesn't matter at this point. Let's get back on topic.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: The moment I saw that photo, some things clicked in my head that I wasn't sure of before.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'll admit it, I was jealous of Margaret, but I'm not sure whether it was her combat prowess, her Originium Arts, her being a Pegasus, or the 'Nearl' name.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: None of those things matter. You wouldn't envy the Radiant Knight over little things like that.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I guess I was just sad that I couldn't be like her, charging towards a goal from start to finish. Without hesitation, fearing neither hardship nor darkness.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: ...You've never thought about stepping back into the arena?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I'd rather die.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: So... do you miss your competitive days?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: At least I knew what I wanted back then.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: ...May I write an article and publish what you just said?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Knock yourself out. I don't care, and the people I care about don't care either.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Will you buy a copy of the Four Seasons Times next week to read it?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's cross that bridge when we come to it, shall we?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: One copy of the Central Journal, please.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Here you go, kid. There aren't many people like you who read the papers these days.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: You talk too much, gramps.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Hey, it's a bit old-fashioned, but you should buy another one if you're waiting for someone.

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: You've been following her around for so long, you really think I wouldn't notice the camera behind your newspaper? Look, she's coming this way right now.
When she sees the familiar figure, the reporter perks up, raising her camera and pointing it at the woman across the street.
In her right hand is a freshly-bought cup of coffee, wispy steam coming off the rim of the cup.

When she gets to her car, she moves the cup from her right hand to her left and tries to grab the keys from her purse. Her left hand is impaired, and the coffee is very hot, so she can only hold it from an awkward position.
Upon seeing her distress, passersby try to help her on multiple occasions, but each time she refuses.
Seeing the woman grit her teeth in pain and rummage through her purse for her keys, the reporter cannot help but squeeze her camera tightly.
The look on her face reminds her of the videos she had seen, where this woman fought against all sorts of powerful enemies with a similar expression.
After a painstaking amount of time, the woman finally manages to wrestle the ring of keys from her purse.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Why'd you put the camera down? Not going to shoot?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: There's no need.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Why not?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: She found it.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Her keys were right there in her purse. She was going to dig them out sooner or later.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Hahahaha!

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Hey kid, keep your hands on the handlebars when you're riding a bike!

steps.name: Immature Reporter
steps.text: Catch you later, gramps!

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: Heh. Kids these days.
Good evening, Al.

steps.name: Newsstand Owner
steps.text: One copy of the Central Journal?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: No, I'll have a copy of the Four Seasons Times, please.
